description: This file defines a utility function orderFiles that sorts a list of file paths based on their relative paths from a given root directory. It includes a struct for handling file path information and performs sorting to order files.

classes.name: orderedFile
classes.description: A struct holding the absolute and relative paths of a file for sorting purposes.

methods.name: orderFiles
methods.description: Orders a list of file paths based on their relative paths from the specified root directory, returning the sorted list.
